chapter: St. Cyr, Dreamland and the OK festival
title: The OKeh record festival and who performed
summary: She recalls appearing in the later OKeh festival, with the house band and recording artists present, and thinks she sang You're a Real Sweetheart.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. You didn't happen to tell Ray Dowell, who put on a program a little while ago, that you were in that program, did you? Well, were you in the first OK Record Festival or in the second? Because there were two, one in February and one a little later in spring, maybe in April or May.

Do you remember? Yeah. Well, I must have, I wasn't in but one. So I must have been in the later one then, because I think it was, I don't think it was cool when I was in it, and I think it must have been, I must have been in the later one.

Do you remember Butterbean's being in it? Sure. Because he spoke about being in it, and he said that one of them ran all night long, and he left at four o'clock in the morning and was still going. Do you remember something like that, that had so much talent that they just didn't?
When I left, when I left it was still going on. Mm-hmm.
Who were some of the people who performed with you, do you recall now?
Oh, my goodness. Yeah. Sheppie Hill, you remember her name? Yes. Sheppie Hill, and, and, uh, uh, uh.
Clarence Williams, have any of his people there? Uh, he was recording with, uh, uh, we mentioned Sarah Martin and, uh, uh, uh, Sippy Wallace.
I tell you, uh, most of the people that were, were, uh, recording for OK was there. Most of them. Who did you perform with? With Louie's group?
No, just with the orchestra, you know, just. The house band?
The house band, you know. All of them did. They used the house band.
They just had their own music, you know, and used the house band. Do you remember the number that you performed?
Well, I think I sang one of the numbers that I, that I recorded. Improvably.

Uh-huh. I think I did. I think I, uh, I think I, I think I sang, uh, I think I, I think I sang, You're a Real Sweetheart. I think that's what I sang. You were real, sweetheart. Oh, I can't give you anything but love, one of those pieces I sang. Mm-hmm.
